data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Multi-Agent Tokenomics & Grilling Master Enterprise FAQ, Decision Matrices, and L400/PCA Scenario Compendium
data.description: Capstone L200/L300/L400 synthesis for Multi-Agent AI Tokenomics and Grilling Architectures on Google Cloud, uniting a 12-dimension quantitative decision matrix, an extended 16-line Cymbal Enterprise FinOps TCO calculator (11.0x / 90.9% cost reduction), a production ADK 2.0 Unified Tokenomics Governance Harness, 16 multi-tier enterprise FAQs, 8 PCA/L400 certification scenarios with mathematical derivations, and 5 Well-Architected Framework pillar case studies.
